title: Vals Index v2.2 updates four benchmarks
summary: Vals Index v2.2 updates Finance Agent, Excel Modeling, Code Migration, and Harvey's LAB, with stricter judges and Code Migration running on the Pi harness. Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Opus 5.5, and Gemini 4 Argon lead, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is the top open-weight model at eighth.
